title: Contracts: scene-message envelope + scene-json pin
description: Per CONTEXT.md, src/contracts/ is a no-deps layer. Define: scene-message.ts (versioned envelope { v: 1; kind: 'scene'|'error'|'ping'; payload }) and scene-json.ts (pinned tldraw scene-JSON shape). Imports nothing - lint enforced. Both domain/emit (producer) and viewer/ (consumer) reference these types. This is the one shared surface between CLI-side and viewer.
close_reason: Landed src/contracts/diagnostic.ts (SourceSpan + Diagnostic shared between domain and viewer), scene-json.ts (structural pin of tldraw document store snapshot), scene-message.ts (v=1 envelope with scene/error/ping). Plus builders.ts (sceneMessage, sceneJson, document/page/box/note/frame/arrow records, arrowBinding, richText) reusable in tests now and emit later. 23 tests pass; depcruise confirms contracts/ has no internal deps.

title: Spike: tldraw scene-JSON contract
description: Open question 1 from docs/roadmap.md. Determine the exact tldraw scene JSON structure for shapes, bindings, and camera so emit/ has a real target. Approach: read tldraw source or capture JSON from a manual session. Output: a documented type for SceneJSON in src/domain/emit/types.ts plus 1-2 reference fixtures under tests/e2e/fixtures/. This unblocks emit/ and viewer/.
close_reason: Documented the wire shape in docs/scene-json.md (it's a tldraw document store snapshot - { store, schema }). Pinned tldraw@^3.15. Wrote two reference fixtures under tests/e2e/fixtures/scene-json/. Surfaced two followups (tldsl-94q hand-rolled rich text, tldsl-09k round-trip test). Note: bd issue described output location as src/domain/emit/types.ts but CONTEXT.md owns this in src/contracts/scene-json.ts - that's tldsl-5lw's job to land the actual TS pin.

title: Bootstrap toolchain: package.json, tsconfig, eslint, dependency-cruiser, vitest
description: Stand up the TypeScript toolchain per CONTEXT.md and docs/lint-config.md. Greenfield error-mode lint from day 1. Package layout: src/{cli,app,domain,infra,viewer}. Includes tsconfig with strict mode, vitest config, eslint flat or rc config from docs/lint-config.md, dependency-cruiser config, package.json scripts (lint, lint:deps, test, typecheck, check).
close_reason: Landed configs from docs/lint-config.md verbatim; npm run check passes on empty src/; verified eslint catches node:fs from domain and depcruise catches domain→infra.

title: Decide IDs: explicit-required + namespace + reorder-stable rules
description: Per CONTEXT.md, ID rules: explicit id required on addressable elements (referenced by <edge> or later <use>); imports prefix child IDs by <import name>; anonymous IDs only for non-addressable visual elements; sibling reorder must not change IDs; renaming an id is a breaking change. Encoded as: parser captures id attrs; ir/ enforces 'addressable element missing id' diagnostic; ir/ generates synthetic IDs only for non-addressable elements (path-stable but reorder-resistant - e.g. content-hash + occurrence index). Add tests under domain/ir/ asserting reorder does not change IDs.

title: Smoke fixture: 5-node auth flow
description: Author tests/e2e/fixtures/auth.tldsl + auth.scene.json: a 5-node auth flow that exercises box, edge, frame, note. This is the success-criterion fixture from CONTEXT.md. Used by tldsl check e2e and as a manual smoke for tldsl serve.

title: Wire PostToolUse hook for tldsl check
description: Add .claude/settings.json hook from architecture.md so Write|Edit tool calls invoke tldsl check on the edited file. Verify: invalid edit produces inline diagnostic in agent context within one tool turn. This is the success criterion in CONTEXT.md.

title: Viewer: tldraw bundle + transport client
description: Implement src/viewer/. Vite-built bundle: tldraw + a transport client that subscribes to scene messages and applies them to the tldraw store. Per CONTEXT.md, viewer is its own world - imports nothing from cli/app/domain/infra. Only contract is the scene JSON message format on the transport.

title: CLI: tldsl serve command
description: Implement src/cli/serve.ts. Argv parsing, builds real Caps including transport + devserver, invokes watchAndServe, opens browser. E2E smoke: spawn the CLI against a fixture file, hit a URL, confirm scene JSON arrives over the transport.

title: CLI: tldsl check command
description: Implement src/cli/check.ts. Argv parsing, builds real Caps, invokes compileFile use case, writes diagnostics via StdioPort, exits with appropriate code. E2E test against tests/e2e/fixtures/{good,broken}.tldsl - exit 0 on valid, non-zero with expected diagnostic on invalid. This is the surface used by the PostToolUse hook.

title: CLI: format-diagnostics + exit (no port abstraction)
description: Per CONTEXT.md, no StdioPort. Use cases return values; cli/ formats diagnostics and calls process.exit. Implement src/cli/format-diagnostics.ts (takes Diagnostic[], renders plain-text per the source-span model). Unit-tested directly. process.exit is called only at cli/ entry points.

title: Infra: dev server (HTTP + SSE host, no port)
description: Implement src/infra/devserver/. Exports startDevServer({ port, viewerBundleDir, transport }). Hosts the HTTP route serving the viewer bundle and the SSE endpoint that the transport adapter writes to. Per CONTEXT.md there is NO DevServerPort - one impl, no test variation. CLI composes and calls startDevServer; HTTP/SSE code stays here, not in cli/. Contract test runs an in-process server, hits the bundle URL, opens an EventSource against the SSE endpoint, asserts a pushed scene message arrives.

title: Infra: SSE transport (decision: SSE for MVP)
description: Per CONTEXT.md, SSE locked for MVP (one-way push fits; native EventSource in browser; reconnect is built in). Websocket reserved for phase 2 if round-trip needs bidirectional. Implement src/infra/transport/ + InMemoryTransport fake at src/app/ports/transport.fake.ts. Contract test runs against shared transport.contract.ts. Wire format = contracts/scene-message.ts (versioned envelope { v, kind, payload }). The partial-render-on-error decision (tldsl-8mu) shapes the kind="error" payload but does not block transport landing - default to last message wins; can layer caching later.

title: Infra: fs adapter (read + watch via chokidar)
description: Implement src/infra/fs/. FsPort with read() + watch(); real adapter uses node:fs/promises and chokidar. InMemoryFs fake under src/infra/fs/fake.ts. Contract test runs both against the same scenarios (catches fake drift, per docs/testing.md).

title: App: watchAndServe use case
description: Implement src/app/watch-and-serve.ts. Use case: watch root file (and imports when phase 2), recompile on change, push scene JSON via TransportPort. Debounce via ClockPort. Integration tests with FakeFs + FakeClock + InMemoryTransport: edit triggers recompile, scene message lands on transport.

title: App: compileFile use case
description: Implement src/app/compile-file.ts. Use case: read .tldsl, parse → ir → layout → emit, return { sceneJson, diagnostics }. Takes Caps (CONTEXT.md capability bundle) as parameter. Integration tests with fakes for every port. Pure orchestration - no I/O of its own.

title: Domain: diagnostics types + plain-text formatter
description: Implement src/domain/diagnostics/. Error types for parser/ir/layout/emit, plus a plain-text formatter for tldsl check output (per architecture.md, tldsl check writes plain text not structured JSON so the model reads it directly). Layout report schema (open question 3) decided here: include computed positions sufficient for spatial reasoning without a screenshot. Unit tests for formatting.

title: Domain: emit (IR-with-positions → tldraw scene JSON)
description: Implement src/domain/emit/. Pure function: IR-with-positions → SceneJSON. Snapshot tests under src/domain/emit/__snapshots__/. Depends on the scene-JSON spike landing first so SceneJSON type is real. Default-center anchor for MVP (full 13-anchor scheme is phase 2).

title: Infra: ELK layout adapter (elkjs)
description: Implement src/infra/layout-elk/. Real LayoutPort adapter using elkjs (decisions.md #5). Translates IR layout attrs (free, row, col, grid, auto) into ELK options. Hard pins via x,y bypass ELK. Contract tests against the shared layout.contract.ts. Per CONTEXT.md, elkjs is import-restricted to this directory.

title: Domain: layout port + stub fake
description: Define LayoutPort interface in src/domain/ports/layout.ts: takes IR, returns IR-with-positions. Implement StubLayout fake (deterministic positions, e.g. grid layout) for unit tests. The real ELK adapter is a separate issue under infra/. Includes a contract test that both the stub and the real adapter must pass.

title: Domain: IR (lower AST → normalized IR)
description: Implement src/domain/ir/. AST → IR. Resolves derived IDs from element paths (CONTEXT.md 'IDs' section), expands shorthand, applies validation. For MVP: imports are out of scope so no <import> resolution. Output normalized IR ready for layout. Unit tests covering: each diagnostic the lowering can emit, ID derivation determinism.

title: Domain: parser for MVP grammar subset
description: Implement src/domain/parser/. MVP grammar: <doc>, <box>, <note>, <edge>, <frame>. Output AST. Unit tests co-located. Pure - no I/O, no node:* imports. Comments compile to stickies (decisions.md #11). Hard rule: parser rejects visual attrs (pad, bg, border) on <group> (decisions.md #4) - though <group> itself may be deferred past MVP, keep the rule wired so it does not regress later.

title: Integration: round-trip scene-json fixtures through tldraw loadSnapshot
description: Spike tldsl-q9l hand-wrote fixtures from docs without running tldraw. Need an integration test (probably in viewer/ or a small Node-side test using @tldraw/store) that loads tests/e2e/fixtures/scene-json/*.json via loadSnapshot and asserts the store accepts them. This is the safety net that catches schema drift between our pin and the bundled tldraw version.

title: Domain emit must hand-roll rich text (tldraw uses toRichText runtime)
description: Spike tldsl-q9l surfaced this. tldraw's rich-text shape is normally produced by calling toRichText(...) at runtime. Domain is pure - it cannot import tldraw. emit/ must therefore hand-construct the ProseMirror-style {type:'doc', content:[...]} object. Output: a small helper in src/domain/emit/rich-text.ts plus unit tests covering single-line and multi-line text. Acceptance: a fixture text round-trips equal to what toRichText produces.

title: Decide partial-render-on-error behavior
description: Open question 2 from docs/roadmap.md. When the viewer receives an invalid scene (or a build fails mid-watch), does it (a) keep last-good render + show red error banner, or (b) blank canvas + error panel? Last-good is friendlier interactively but requires caching the previous valid scene in transport or viewer. Decide before transport contract is frozen.

title: Infra: clock adapter + FakeClock
description: Per CONTEXT.md, no ClockPort for MVP. Add this when watchAndServe (tldsl-34b) introduces debounce - bursts of file save events need controllable time in tests. Until then, defer. If watchAndServe lands without debounce, this stays open as a tracked future need.
